title: ADCNet: Learning from Raw Radar Data via Distillation
authors: Bo Yang; Ishan Khatri; Michael Happold; Chulong Chen
problem: Automotive radar perception from raw ADC
output: RAD tensor proxy then detection outputs
network: Learnable signal-processing layer and convolutional backbone
teacher_or_classical_baseline: Offline signal-processing/RADIal SDK generates pseudo labels
training: DSP pseudo-label pretraining then perception fine-tuning
real_or_simulated: Raw sensor dataset per paper; exact scene split not re-audited here
metrics: Detection metrics reported in paper; exact values not copied from abstract
reported_result: Authors report state-of-the-art detection on RADIal
limitations: Automotive FMCW and object detection, not airborne 3-channel GMTI; no direct Pfa=1e-6 claim
relation_and_borrowing: Borrow teacher-generated signal-processing targets and preserve task-domain boundary

title: T-FFTRadNet: Object Detection with Swin Vision Transformers from Raw ADC Radar Signals

problem: Automotive FMCW object detection from raw ADC

training: Supervised object detection; no teacher distillation in this work

metrics: Detection metrics/AP and errors in paper; not reproduced here

output: Scene/simulator inputs separating clutter and targets

innovation_coverage: Long-established classical estimator; P0 must compare against credible signal-processing methods

title: Frequency Estimation of a Single Complex Sinusoid Using a Generalized Kay Estimator

relation_and_borrowing: Candidate additional baseline if phase-difference P0 needs refinement
innovation_coverage: Classical high-accuracy baseline; a neural network should not be compared only with raw FFT
